study type: In vitro study using human myometrial explants and in vivo animal study (non-human primate model)
cohort: The study utilized human myometrial explants obtained from biopsies at planned term cesarean and pregnant cynomolgus monkeys.
finding: Retosiban prevented stretch-induced myometrial contractility and ERK1/2 phosphorylation in human explants, and significantly reduced the risk of spontaneous delivery in cynomolgus monkeys.
gest_age: Monkeys: 100 to 150 days of gestational age during treatment; Human biopsies: planned term cesarean
